v1b.raw: {"claims":[{"text":"The invention provides therapeutic antibodies against VSIG1, ILDR1, LOC253012, AI216611, C1ORF32 or FXYD3 antigens.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9107862B2"},{"text":"VSIG1, ILDR1, LOC253012, AI216611, C1ORF32 and FXYD3 are predicted co-stimulatory family members.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9107862B2"},{"text":"VSIG1, ILDR1, LOC253012, AI216611, C1ORF32 and FXYD3 are differentially expressed in cancers including lung cancer, ovarian cancer, and colon cancer.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9107862B2"},{"text":"The use of antibodies against VSIG1, ILDR1, LOC253012, AI216611, C1ORF32 or FXYD3 for modulating B7 costimulation is provided.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9107862B2"},{"text":"The extracellular domains of VSIG1, FXYD3, ILDR1, LOC253012, AI216611, and C1ORF32 and their variants are suitable targets for immunotherapy, cancer therapy, and drug development.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9107862B2"},{"text":"The invention provides nucleic acids encoding B7-related factors that modulate the activation of immune or inflammatory response cells, such as T-cells.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9399052B2"},{"text":"The invention provides expression vectors and fusion constructs comprising nucleic acids encoding B7-related polypeptides, including BSL1, BSL2, and BSL3.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9399052B2"},{"text":"The invention provides isolated B7-related polypeptides, isolated fusion proteins comprising B7-related polypeptides, and antibodies that are specifically reactive with B7-related polypeptides.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9399052B2"},{"text":"The invention provides compositions of B7-related nucleic acids, polypeptides, fusion proteins, or antibodies that are useful for the immunomodulation of a human or animal subject.","status":"supported","doc_id":"uspto:US9399052B2"}],"verdict":"pass","unsupported_count":0}
